name: claude-lead-gen
description: Lead generation and business research toolkit for Claude Code, plus optional keyed provider plugins.

plugins.name: leadgen
plugins.description: Core lead-gen and niche-research agent: skills, subagents, commands, hooks, the leadgen CLI, and the free Playwright MCP.

plugins.name: leadgen-firecrawl
plugins.description: Optional: Firecrawl MCP for JS-heavy crawling, search and structured extraction (API key; free tier).

plugins.name: leadgen-exa
plugins.description: Optional: Exa MCP for semantic company/people search (API key; free tier).

plugins.name: leadgen-brave
plugins.description: Optional: Brave Search MCP, an independent web index for discovery (API key; free tier).

plugins.name: leadgen-tavily
plugins.description: Optional: Tavily MCP for search + extraction tuned for agents (API key; free tier).

plugins.name: leadgen-apify
plugins.description: Optional: Apify MCP for ready-made actors (Google Maps, LinkedIn public pages, review sites) (token; monthly free credit).
